purpose: Authoritative Android architecture and implementation-boundary specification for V4SH.

authority.principle: Antigravity may implement and refine code within these boundaries, but must not silently change product behavior, payment semantics, security rules, or navigation contracts.

platform.design_system: Material 3 adapted to the frozen V4SH design system

core_stack.network_and_telephony: Android platform Telephony APIs where required
core_stack.payment_access: Android AccessibilityService boundary for the proven USSD automation prototype

must_not: Decide whether a payment is SUCCESS, FAILED, UNKNOWN, or CANCELLED
Contain large blocks of QR parsing logic
Depend directly on Compose UI classes
Capture or store UPI PIN, OTP, bank passwords, card PIN, or CVV

responsibilities: Mapping between persistence models and domain models
must_not: Represent local history as a bank statement

responsibilities: Stop safely on sensitive or unknown screens
Surface definitive success/failure or UNKNOWN to the domain layer
payment_engine.boundary: The payment engine must be isolated behind an interface so the rest of the app does not depend directly on AccessibilityService implementation details.

responsibilities: Android settings intents required for setup
platform_access.rule: Platform-specific mechanisms remain behind interfaces/adapters wherever practical.

recommended_package_structure.note: The existing package name may remain com.festpay.app during implementation unless the project explicitly performs a controlled rename. Product branding remains V4SH.

payment_architecture.responsibility: Expose a product-level payment operation without leaking AccessibilityService details into UI.
payment_architecture.critical_rule: The UI must not infer payment outcome from timeout, screen disappearance, or network loss. PaymentEngine/domain logic must determine the correct state using available evidence.

accessibility_architecture.role: Platform adapter for the payment-access prototype.
rules: Classify the current screen before acting.
Use a single-pass traversal where practical.
Stop automation on NON_ACTIONABLE or unknown screens.
Never enter UPI PIN or OTP.
Never write arbitrary values into arbitrary editable fields.
Do not automate unrelated applications or screens.
accessibility_architecture.boundary: AccessibilityService emits classified events/results to the payment engine; business UI must not traverse the accessibility tree directly.

qr_architecture.rule: Scanning and parsing a QR does not itself initiate a payment.

navigation_architecture.rule: Navigation destinations and terminal-state semantics must remain consistent with navigation.json.

appropriate_for: User interface preferences that are actually implemented

preconditions_are_independent: Camera access where QR scanning is used
setup_architecture.rule: Do not collapse independent prerequisites into a single false 'ready' condition.

security_boundaries.rule: These must never enter V4SH application state, local database, debug logs, or application-owned transport.
security_boundaries.accessibility_policy: AccessibilityService is a prototype/feasibility mechanism and must not be assumed to be Play Store compliant without separate policy validation.

safety_tests: No arbitrary editable field receives payment input
No credential is persisted or logged

allowed: Create/refactor Kotlin classes within the defined architecture.
Implement Compose screens matching the frozen design system.
Implement repositories, use cases, state holders, and tests.
Improve code quality without changing product semantics.
Run builds/tests and fix implementation defects.
Use official Android documentation when platform behavior is uncertain.
forbidden: Adding a wallet or V4SH balance.
Adding merchant onboarding or proprietary QR infrastructure.
Replacing the frozen navigation with a new information architecture.
Treating Stitch HTML as production Android code.
